lamps.steady: Reminder to fasten belt. Remains on if unfastened when driving under 20 km/h or stopped.
lamps.flashing: Belt is unfastened while driving 20 km/h or faster. Chime will sound.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with air bag system or seat belt pre-tensioner. See a dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Indicates a malfunction with the air bag system if flashing while ignition is on.

lamps.steady: Parking brake is engaged or brake fluid level is low. Check fluid immediately.
ABS system malfunction. Normal braking remains functional without anti-lock assistance. See dealer.
Malfunction with the Electric Power Steering system. See an authorized dealer.
lamps.flashing: Indicates a malfunction with the Vehicle Stability Management system.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in emission control system or engine protection system. See dealer to avoid damage.
Alternator or electrical charging system malfunction. Stop safely and check the drive belt.
Engine oil pressure is low. Stop safely and check oil level immediately to prevent damage.
Fuel tank is nearly empty. Add fuel as soon as possible.

lamps.flashing: Vehicle speed exceeds 120 km/h. Slow down to stop the warning.

lamps.steady: Soot accumulated in exhaust. Drive over 80 km/h for 30 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: GPF system requires dealer inspection despite driving procedure.

lamps.steady: Indicates a malfunction in the ESC system. Contact a dealer.
lamps.flashing: The ESC system is actively operating.

lamps.steady: The ESC system has been deactivated by the driver.
A vehicle door is not closed securely.
The tailgate is not closed securely.
Key or smart key detected; engine can be started. Also indicates smart key detection failure.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction in immobilizer system, or smart key is missing or has a weak battery.

lamps.steady: Indicates a malfunction if the light stays on without blinking.
lamps.flashing: Turn signal is operating. Rapid flashing indicates a system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Headlamps are turned on.
Headlights are in high beam or flash-to-pass position.
Parking lights or headlights are switched on.
Front fog lights are turned on.
Rear fog lights are turned on.
Indicates service is due or a monitored system like TPMS has a malfunction.

lamps.flashing: Smart key is not in vehicle while ignition is in ACC or ON.

lamps.lamp: Low Tire Pressure Warning / TPMS Malfunction
lamps.steady: One or more tires are significantly underinflated. Check and inflate tires immediately.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with the Tire Pressure Monitoring System. See dealer.
